test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’,

A @ B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A - B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

and A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is O related to V if ‘O @ P + T # G - V’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 @
 -
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: ‘O @ P + T # G - V’

It means: O is the Brother of P, P is the Sister of T, T is the Father of G, G is the Wife of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9884e66fd4e102dee950e3104022e15f840e399a93e20b1963999cdef5a2873d.png] 

So, O is the **Wife's father's brother** of V.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
